name: archetype
derived_from: https://www.archetypeai.io/ (measured in a browser: off-white #f1f1f0, ink #1a1a1a, light headings, small uppercase mono labels, near-square corners). The site has no dark mode; the dark theme is derived. Accent is the house coral #ff5c48 from aws_agent docs/image-gen/styles/precision/palettes/light-coral.json. The accent is Forest green (chosen 2026-09-30 from six options). The house coral #ff5c48 from aws_agent docs/image-gen/styles/precision/palettes/light-coral.json is kept for error and warning only.

sans.note: Free stand-in for PP Neue Montreal (paid), which the reference site uses.

mono.note: Stand-in for PP Neue Montreal Mono.

fonts.embed_note: Latin and latin-extended subsets (Western and Central European). Files are paths relative to the skill folder, embedded into each page as base64 with their unicode ranges, so a page needs no network for fonts and the browser uses the right file per character. Characters outside these (for example Thai in an Envato title) fall back to the system font.

button.usage: Buttons, links and the theme toggle

subtle.usage: Subtle labels (was #707070 in 0.1.0; darkened for contrast)

accent.usage: Accent for shapes, bars, borders, arrows (Forest green)

accenttext.usage: Accent for small text (deeper in light for contrast, 4.5:1)

soft.usage: Accent tint used for the dark-mode hover fill

warning.usage: Warning shapes and bars (house coral; a separate token so it can differ later)

btnarrow.usage: Button arrow, readable on both the outlined and the solid button

fpady.usage: Filter panel padding, top and bottom

button.rest: transparent fill, 1px inside outline and text in button colour
button.hover_focus: solid fill in button colour, text in button-text colour
button.pressed: solid fill mixed 82% with page background
button.disabled: rest look at 40% opacity, no hover
button.focus_ring: 2px focus-colour ring, 2px offset (ink on light, accent on dark)

chip_and_pill.note: Static in the gallery. The states apply only to an interactive chip, marked with class is-action. A pill is a chip with class pill (fully round).
chip_and_pill.hover_focus: accent text and border, accent tint fill
chip_and_pill.pressed: as hover with the tint doubled, capped at 24%
chip_and_pill.selected: solid fill in button colour, button-text colour

states.motion: 0.14s ease on colour, background and border. None when the visitor prefers reduced motion.

accepted_debt: Hover and pressed text on the accent tint in light mode is roughly 3.5 to 4.5:1 for interactive chips, pagination and the calendar. Not yet addressed (see accent_audit).
Subtle text #707070 measures 4.4:1 on light and 4.2:1 on dark, just under 4.5:1. Accepted.
Hairline border is 1.2:1 on light. Decorative, accepted.
open: The six light-mode hover-tint states are below 4.5:1 (see accent_audit.proposal_not_applied).
Brand logo: support is built, no logo file has been supplied yet (see brand).

components.note: Built from the locked tokens on 2026-09-30. Component states reuse the interaction rules under "states".

text_input.font: sans 15px weight 300 (not 200, for legibility while typing)
text_input.focus: outline in ink plus a 2px accent ring, 2px offset
text_input.error: outline in the error colour, plus a 7px error-colour square and ink help text (no small coloured text)
text_input.label: mono 11px weight 300, uppercase, muted

select.note: as text input, with a two-triangle chevron and 34px right padding

table.header: mono 11px weight 400, uppercase, 1px ink rule under it
table.cell: sans 15px weight 300, hairline rule between rows
table.overflow: wrap in a scrolling container on narrow screens

callout.base: surface fill, hairline border, 3px ink bar on the left
callout.error: error-colour bar, doubled error-colour tint fill
callout.title: mono 11px weight 400, uppercase

code.block: surface fill, hairline border, mono 13px weight 300
code.inline: mono at 0.88em, surface fill, hairline border

modal.panel: surface fill, hairline border, 24px padding, close cross top right

backdrop.note: lighter in dark mode so the panel sits on a visible backdrop

modal.actions: ghost text button (ink, accent on hover) plus the standard button

empty_and_error.eyebrow: mono 11px weight 400, uppercase; error adds a 7px error-colour square

loading.skeleton: hairline-coloured bars, pulsing opacity, no pulse when reduced motion is preferred

tabs.tab: mono 12px weight 400, uppercase, muted text; hover ink; selected ink with a 2px accent underline; focus 2px accent ring; disabled 40%
tabs.list: 1px hairline under the row, scrolls sideways on narrow screens

tooltip.panel: button-fill background, button-text colour, mono 11px weight 400 uppercase, 7px 10px padding, 1px radius, 9px arrow

toast.panel: button-fill background, button-text colour, sans 15px weight 300, 12px 16px padding
toast.error: 52px error-colour square flush to the left, top and bottom edges, with a white square-capped cross (18px, 2.4px stroke); replaces the thin bar
toast.action: mono 12px uppercase, underlined, accent on hover
toast.error_note: White on the error colour (coral #ff5c48) is 3.05:1, enough for a graphic (3:1), not for text. The message text stays in the button-text colour.

pagination.item: 32px minimum square, mono 12px weight 400 uppercase, hairline box
pagination.hover: accent box and text with tint fill

navigation.link: mono 11px weight 400 uppercase, ink; numbered prefix in subtle grey (_01)

date_picker.grid: 7 columns of 36px cells, Monday first, weekday row mono 11px weight 300

interactive_edges.note: The rest edge of an interactive chip and of pagination uses the muted outline colour (5.56:1 light, 8.03:1 dark), as form fields do. Static gallery chips keep the hairline.

touch_targets.note: Under a coarse pointer, buttons, fields, tabs, pagination, navigation, interactive chips, toggles, the ghost button, toast controls, modal close and calendar cells are at least 44px (the calendar grid widens to 44px cells). The tuner has a Touch switch to preview it.

theme_switch.default: system (follows the display setting, and updates live if the display setting changes)
theme_switch.control: three icon buttons in one group: sun (Light), moon (Dark), monitor (System). 16px, 1.5px outline icons, 32x30px buttons, 1px radius group. Selected is the solid button fill; unselected hover is accent.
theme_switch.icons_source: The sun, moon-02 and monitor-01 icons from the Vaultia chat app icon map (aws_agent UI/chat/src/app/shared/icon/icon-map.ts). Their upstream licence has not been checked.
theme_switch.memory: The chosen mode is remembered in the browser (localStorage, guarded so the page still works if storage is blocked).
theme_switch.accessibility: Each button has a text label and title; the pressed state is exposed with aria-pressed.
theme_switch.shipped_gallery: The shipped gallery page gets this switch; the tuner keeps its Tune and Touch buttons beside it.

accessibility.method: Browser audit of computed styles in both themes: text contrast for every text style on the tuner page (including forced hover, pressed and disabled samples), boundary contrast for form fields, chips, pagination and buttons, focus ring contrast, and control sizes.

text_findings.coral_on_light: Coral small text on the light page is 2.7:1 (toggle rest, eyebrow, hover and pressed states of chips, pagination, navigation, calendar). Accepted by the owner; not changed.
text_findings.subtle_grey: Resolved in 0.4.0: subtle text is now #6a6a6a light and #7a7a7a dark.
text_findings.dark_pressed_chip: Coral text on the doubled 32% tint in dark is 4.42:1.
text_findings.inactive_controls: Disabled controls at 40% opacity measure 1.7 to 3.4:1. Inactive controls are exempt from WCAG contrast rules; recorded for information.

non_text.interactive_chip_and_pagination_edges: Resolved in 0.4.0: muted outline at rest.
non_text.focus_ring: Resolved in 0.4.0: ink ring on light, coral on dark.

control_sizes_px.note: After 0.4.0: 24px minimum everywhere, 44px under a coarse pointer. Sizes above are the desktop pointer measurements before the 24px fix.

proposals_not_applied.change: Optional light-mode-only coral for small text and focus ring: #c73826 (4.62:1 on the page, 5.04:1 on surface). The owner declined a deeper coral on 2026-09-30, so this stays a proposal.

applied_2026-09-30.result: #6a6a6a on light 4.79:1, #7a7a7a on dark 4.89:1. Text failures fell from 16 to 11 (light) and 7 to 2 (dark).
Interactive chip and pagination edges 5.56:1 light, 8.03:1 dark.
Focus ring is ink on light (15.4:1) and coral on dark (6.88:1).
24px minimum everywhere; 44px under a coarse pointer, verified with the Touch preview.
Pressed tint capped at 24%: coral text on it is 5.2:1 in dark.

remaining_after_fixes.light: 11 text styles, all coral small text on the light page (accepted 2026-09-30)

accessibility.note: The measurements and fixes in this section were made with the coral accent (themes 0.1 to 0.6). See accent_audit for the Forest accent that replaced it.

spacing_scale.note: Spacing values sit on this scale. Named size-N, N in px (the reference site names its own sizes the same way). Locked 2026-09-30.
spacing_scale.tie_break: Where a value sat exactly between two steps (6, 10, 14, 28) it was rounded up, because the tuning had moved towards airier spacing.

decisions_confirmed: Selected chips and pills use the solid look (confirmed 2026-09-30).
Button pressed fill is an 82% mix of the button fill and the page (confirmed 2026-09-30).

tint_percent.note: Hover fill for chips, pills, pagination and the calendar (accent), and the fill of the error and warning callouts. Pressed doubles it, capped at 24%.

accent_audit.method: The same browser audit as above, on the tuner page with the Forest accent, in both modes.

light.detail: All six are hover or pressed text on the accent tint fill (interactive chip and pill, pagination, calendar day), roughly 3.5 to 4.5:1. Eyebrow, toggles, links, tabs and navigation pass.

accent_audit.compared_with_coral: Coral had 11 light failures (all small coral text); Forest has 6, and they are only the hover-tint states.
accent_audit.proposal_not_applied: Lower the light-mode tint (for example 5%) or deepen the hover text so the six hover-tint states reach 4.5:1.

brand.note: The owner's personal-brand mark. Support is in the builder; no file yet, so pages show none.

placement_options.above: above the eyebrow, in the header
placement_options.topleft: fixed at the top left, level with the colour-mode switch

brand.file_rules: A path relative to the skill folder (or absolute). SVG preferred, PNG, JPEG and WebP also work. logo_dark is optional; without it, invert_in_dark inverts a black logo.
